diagram_math_checks.justification: The Remarks specifies E={0,1,2} subset Z, nu_1=-1, nu_2=1, a_1(1)=2, a_2(1)=1 and zero endpoint rates. In def-reaction-network-propensity-system-and-generator Definition, positive rates require x+nu_j in E: 1-1=0 and 1+1=2 satisfy this; zero endpoint rates create no out-of-state active transitions.

Exactly three vertices and two directed edges are drawn: 1 to 0 for j=1 and 1 to 2 for j=2. These implement procedure step 5, x<-x+nu_J; no reverse or additional edges are asserted. The annotation a_j(1) is the corresponding propensity, not a transition probability.

Procedure steps 1 and 3 give lambda(1)=2+1=3 and tau=E_{n+1}/3. Step 4 gives channel 1 on [0,2/3) and channel 2 on [2/3,1), with U=1 assigned to largest positive index 2. The surrounding text includes this endpoint and writes the correct marked event (t+tau,J,1+nu_J).

The arrows are explicitly conditional on an available budget and t+tau<T. Step 2 stops at exhausted budget before step 3; step 3 instead holds at state 1 when t+tau>=T. At 0 and 2 lambda=0, so step 1 absorbs before any budget check. These are marked-event rates, consistent with the supplier definition; this example has no zero-increment channels.

The figure is outside the Definition and all Facts/proof-like sections. The complete original procedure is retained byte-for-byte; the explanatory example does not supply a proof premise or assert finite pseudorandom exactness. The rigorous algorithm remains independent of the figure.
